offering_description.value: Provides engineering, specialty health care and information technology staffing and project services to businesses, mainly in the US. It supplies skilled professionals on contract or project basis and bills clients for their time and services.

primary_services.value: engineering services; specialty health care staffing; IT staffing and consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: utilities, industrial and power companies, pharmaceutical and life sciences firms, healthcare providers, IT clients

end_markets.value: power and utilities; industrial manufacturing; life sciences; healthcare; information technology

revenue_model.value: service fees: hourly or daily bill rates for contract staff and consultants; project or contract: fixed-fee or time-and-materials engineering and IT project work

value_chain_position.value: service provider: supplies engineers, healthcare professionals and IT staff to corporate clients

geography_served.value: US national: Offices across many US states, serving clients nationwide

specialization.value: diversified: Engineering, specialty health care and information technology staffing and solutions, each with different customers
